name: EN-01 Ruin Skitter
description: Original dark fantasy pixel art for a ruined magical academy RPG. Crisp pixel clusters, limited desaturated blue gray stone and weathered bronze palette, upper-left lighting, thin dark outline, readable at native resolution. No text, no letters, no watermark. Ruin Skitter, an unsettling small hunched bipedal arcane vermin with long claws and a ragged silhouette, dusty charcoal skin, small amber eyes. Full body standing, centered, visible feet, transparent background, no scenery.
